description:
- New DeskRecorder feature `"audio"`: a standalone, timestamped recording
  of one picked input device, independent of `"transcribe"`'s own
  microphone use -- for when the saved audio track itself matters (e.g.
  compositing it with a screen/camera recording). `desk.recorder.start`/
  `desk_recorder_control` take `feature: "audio"` with `{device}` opts
  (`"default"` or a name from `sources()`, which now also returns
  `{ sources: { microphone: [...] } }`).
- `desk.transcripts.read`/`desk_read_transcript` segments now also carry
  `parts`: `[{ text, start_ms, end_ms }, ...]`, whisper's own finer
  timestamps inside that segment -- each more accurate than the whole
  segment's own span. `[]` for a transcript pool written before `parts`
  existed.
